name: How is dust and debris controlled during a shower demolition?

mainEntity.name: How is dust and debris controlled during a shower demolition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Managing dust requires a combination of physical barriers, floor protection, and localized air control. Breaking out shower tile, dry mortar, and backer board releases fine particulate matter that can settle throughout living areas. Professional crews seal doorways with heavy plastic sheeting, mask HVAC return registers in the work zone, and lay neoprene runners or drop cloths across hallways and entryways. Running a portable air scrubber or creating negative pressure directed out an open window keeps airborne dust from drifting into adjacent living spaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Crews isolate the room using heavy plastic zippered barriers, cover adjacent flooring, block HVAC vents, and run negative air filtration to capture airborne dust.
